meta.title: GATBOX machine specs: per-machine rail limits
meta.keyed_by: roster slug (gatbox-barcade-roster.json). Slugs are permanent; names are not.
meta.why_separate: Kept out of the roster on purpose, so the maintenance app's roster import never sees a new field.
meta.rails_format: rail id -> [lo, hi] in volts DC at the board's power input. Rail ids are ASCII: "+5V", "+12V", "-5V" (plain hyphen-minus; show a real minus sign only on screen).
meta.rule: Only numbers from the machine's own manual or service docs, with the source cited. A machine's spec for a rail overrides the profile window for that rail.

gauntlet-legends.source: Gauntlet Legends manual, DC voltage limits (per the owner, 2026-09-25)
